fontPreviewText:
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
Pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs.
How vexingly quick daft zebras jump!
Sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow.
Waltz, bad nymph, for quick jigs vex.
The five boxing wizards jump quickly.

stressDialogMessage: For pushing the knowledge graph and friends to their limits. Each entry links to {min}–{max} random others and its title starts with “{prefix}”, so they can all be removed in one go.
repairSubtitle: Check and fix card previews, media references and dangling categories
repairMessage:
This scans every entry, regenerates card previews and media references from the body text, clears dangling category references, and rebuilds the search index.

Only derived data that can be recomputed from the body is touched — your text is never modified.
repairAllGood: Everything checks out — nothing to repair.
resetSubtitle: Erase every entry, setting and media file — cannot be undone
resetMessage:
This permanently deletes every entry, category, media file and font, along with all settings — sync configuration, encryption keys, the app lock password and the rest. It cannot be undone.

Make sure you have a backup. The app will close once you confirm; reopen it to finish the reset.
